analysis:
Examined the InferenceHandler head excerpt (lines ~1144-1557) and the ModelLoading patch/base. InferenceHandler: the only change renames v2UsageSignal.firstWithheldReasoningAt to firstWithheldOutputAt (lines 1147, 1217). It is used for the pre-content deadline check and TTFT sampling. No change to hashing, encryption, usage settlement, cache scope or terminal paths; the response hash domain (fullResponseText) and billing floors are untouched. Withheld output is still not framed, so the hash commits to emitted bytes. Whether the signal is now also set for withheld answer text is defined elsewhere (not supplied). The effect is limited to deadline and TTFT bookkeeping, with no confidentiality impact.

ModelLoading: (1) The weight hashers now go through an injected `loadWeightHasher` instead of the hard-coded WeightHasher.computeHash (patch lines ~47, 60, 76-78). The property's definition and default were not supplied. If production does not default to WeightHasher.computeHash, attestation and cache-identity hashes (T-012, T-027, T-041) would be affected; this is an unverified contract. (2) The managed GLM path no longer calls captureWeightHash before and after load. It now uses fileIdentities, glmPlan.weights.recheck(), and GLM5NextManagedLoad.adopting, then verifiedGLM5NextWeightHash(load:plan:modelPath:) and recordVerifiedGLM5NextWeightHash. Their implementations were not supplied, so I cannot confirm that the verified digest is bound to the bytes actually loaded (TOCTOU between SHA verification and mmap). The new code passes the same verified digest as both preLoad and postLoad to finalizeReusableSSDLoad, so the changed-during-load check is neutralized for GLM and relies entirely on the managed loader's verification. The removed requireGLM5NextLoadedArtifact check is presumably folded into the verification, which also is not visible. (3) A non-GLM path with a nil preLoadHash throws managedLoadRequired, which fails closed. A GLM plan with a nil glmLoad also falls through to the throw, which fails closed.

No concrete regression is established from the supplied evidence. Integration should verify verifiedGLM5NextWeightHash, recordVerifiedGLM5NextWeightHash, the loadWeightHasher default, and the firstWithheldOutputAt producer.
